description: This file defines the Email class which implements Serializable and encapsulates email-related properties such as sender, recipient, subject, template name, and template tokens.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: A class representing an email message with properties for sender, recipient, subject, template, and tokens.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the sender of the email.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender of the email.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the recipient of the email.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient of the email.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject line of the email.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject line of the email.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the template name used for the email.

methods.name: setTemplateName
methods.description: Sets the template name for the email.

methods.name: getTemplateTokens
methods.description: Returns the map of template tokens used for email customization.

methods.name: setTemplateTokens
methods.description: Sets the map of template tokens.

methods.name: setFromEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the sender.

methods.name: getFromEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the sender.
